headline: China Open Round 1: Sinner and Sabalenka cruise as Beijing crowd roars
whyCareReason: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner launched his title defense with a crisp straight-sets win, while Aryna Sabalenka and Zheng Qinwen ignited the Beijing crowd.
teaser: Wednesday 30 September at National Tennis Center. Sinner downs Safiullin 6-3, 6-4; Sabalenka and Zheng advance in dominant fashion on Diamond Court.
story:
Why this one matters: The main draw of the 2026 China Open kicked into high gear on Wednesday in Beijing, and the marquee names delivered clinical performances under bright autumn sunshine at the National Tennis Center.

Reigning champion and world No. 1 Jannik Sinner opened his campaign with an authoritative 6-3, 6-4 victory over Roman Safiullin. Sinner won 84 percent of his first-serve points and never faced a break point, displaying the icy efficiency that carried him through a dominant summer. Up next for the Italian is a second-round duel as Carlos Alcaraz prepares for his opening test on Thursday.

On Diamond Court, the WTA 1000 field produced fireworks. Aryna Sabalenka dismantled Anhelina Kalinina 6-2, 6-3 behind 28 winners, while Olympic gold medalist Zheng Qinwen brought 15,000 roaring fans to their feet with a 6-1, 6-1 masterclass over Kamilla Rakhimova.
stakes: Crucial 500 and 1000 ranking points determine qualification for the season-ending ATP and WTA Finals in Turin and Riyadh.
rivalryAngle: Sinner and Alcaraz renew their global chess match as the tour shifts to the outdoor hardcourts of Asia.
